plan.stopping: Stop after three successful, nonempty, equal normalized labels; otherwise request two more. A transport failure makes the policy unsuccessful.
plan.selection: Normalized-label plurality; earliest sample position breaks ties. No target access during selection.
plan.latency: Admission to policy worker through answer selection; includes prompt-copy, gateway queue, provider retry/backoff and second batch; excludes waiting for a task-worker slot and export.
plan.load: Four admitted tasks at a time within a single-policy block, at most twenty simultaneous provider calls; no competing experimental policy block.
plan.failure: Keep every attempt. Transport-exhausted policies score zero and have a separate failure rate. Started policies are never relaunched after a host interruption; their latency is unavailable. Resume only unstarted tasks.
plan.pause: Heartbeat every second; gaps exceeding 10 seconds or wall/monotonic disagreement exceeding 5 seconds flag overlapping policies. Report all and unflagged latency separately.
plan.population: 412 previously inspected released tasks; new model calls, not an untouched test or optimizer result.
plan.inference: Same capped large-context prompt, solver and native graders as engineering E; no response reuse across policies, repetitions, temperatures or sample positions.
plan.execution: Reviewed fixed Python orchestration on host through the existing metered gateway; no model-generated code, cloud sandbox or worker filesystem/network isolation claim.
